fields.label: Automation Enabled
fields.description: Switch off to pause both action generation and queued dispatch. This is the global automation control.

fields.label: Reminder Days Before Due
fields.description: Comma-separated day offsets. 0 means due today.

fields.label: Terminal Statuses
fields.description: Comma-separated statuses treated as closed/terminal. Items in these states are excluded from reminders and escalation.

fields.label: Maximum Attempts
fields.description: Maximum dispatch attempts per execution, including the first attempt. Range: 1–20.

fields.label: Maximum Scheduler Batch Size
fields.description: Maximum number of queued executions processed per scheduler cycle. Range: 1–250.

fields.label: Retry Base Minutes
fields.description: Base delay used for exponential retry backoff. Range: 1–1440 minutes.

fields.label: Retry Maximum Hours
fields.description: Upper cap for retry delay. Range: 1–168 hours.

fields.label: Owner Field Mapping (JSON)
fields.description: Optional mapping of source DocType to owner field. Only known fields are accepted by runtime allowlist.

fields.label: Fallback Recipient Overrides (JSON)
fields.description: Explicit fallback user per source DocType for items without an owner. User is validated as active before delivery.
